description: Defines structures and classes related to time zone information, including Transition, TransitionType, and TimeZoneInfo, for handling time zone data based on the IANA Time Zone Database.
external_methods: bool NextTransition(const time_point<seconds>& tp, time_zone::civil_transition* trans) const
bool PrevTransition(const time_point<seconds>& tp, time_zone::civil_transition* trans) const

classes.name: TimeZoneInfo
classes.description: Represents a time zone backed by the IANA Time Zone Database, capable of loading zone info and providing time conversion functionalities.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads zoneinfo data for a given time zone name.

methods.name: BreakTime
methods.description: Converts a time point to a civil and absolute lookup.

methods.name: MakeTime
methods.description: Converts civil time to a time point.

methods.name: NextTransition
methods.description: Finds the next transition after a given time point.

methods.name: PrevTransition
methods.description: Finds the previous transition before a given time point.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the zoneinfo data.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Provides a description of the time zone.
